snippet.title: Satellite Odyssey Jupiter - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Antifreeze Games' sci-fi noir survival horror puts you in the shoes of May, who faces mutant cockroaches and seductive androids, scavenges for weapons, and solves puzzles on a space station. It's set on a Soviet-inspired base near Jupiter run by an AI called Proton.
